description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahawelgoda, Weligepola D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620148
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land owners, parcel numbers, extents, and property classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, making it a clear example of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
